items.title: Aeroplan offering up to 100% bonus on points purchases
items.why: Deep points-purchase bonuses set a pricing benchmark for transfer partner economics worth tracking.
items.summary_ai: Aeroplan is offering bonuses of up to 100% on points purchases, a promotion that lowers the cost of buying loyalty currency.
